query: If someone sends a wrong transaction on a blockchain, can it be undone, and would anyone see that it happened?
expected_answer: Transactions are final immediately, so reversing an erroneous one requires an equal transaction in the opposite direction, and both transactions remain visible.
expected_facts: transactions are complete and final immediately
reversal requires an equal transaction in the opposite direction

relevant_passages.quote: So, if one party sends an erroneous transaction, reversing it would require an equal transaction in the opposite direction, but both transactions will be visible.
